name: Bellevue
beschreibung: The Gasthof Bellevue is a charming, traditional alpine inn situated in Tyrol. It offers cozy accommodation alongside a rustic dining parlor serving hearty regional dishes. The rooms are neat, comfortable, and simply appointed. Tucked away from major roads in a peaceful setting, the inn allows guests to join guided hikes and explore the surrounding mountains directly from the doorstep. In summer, the inviting beer garden is perfect for lingering. Please note that the front desk is not staffed around the clock, so prior notification of arrival is required.
